narrative: The same uncorrelated background analytics-beacon POST as the -ok sibling, but here a builder over-broadly scoped the precondition_step exemption to the ENTIRE step window instead of the one correlated interaction, wrongly letting the unrelated background request execute (outcome: executed) even though correlated_to_step_interaction=false — an F179/F180 violation: a non-idempotent request that does not satisfy F179's correlation rule MUST NOT be exempted by F40's dry-run boundary, regardless of which step's window it fired in (CR5-B2).
